full_prompt_en: A square pencil and ink study shows a young man from the shoulders up against aged cream paper. His torso turns right while his head tilts back toward the viewer, giving the face a defiant, sidelong angle. Dense dark hair rises in irregular clumps above a narrow forehead. A cigarette projects from one corner of the mouth, with a faint curl of smoke at the left. The eyes are half-lowered, the jaw sharply defined and the neck slightly stretched. Clothing is only lightly indicated by quick collar and shoulder lines, leaving much of the lower right as unfinished paper. Around the head, exploratory pencil marks, crossed guides and scattered scratches remain visible. The face is more heavily worked, with rough hatching along the cheek, nose and under the eye. The color range is limited to black, graphite gray and yellowed cream, with warmer paper staining at the edges. Light is broad and unforced, suggested by untouched paper on the forehead and cheek rather than a painted source. The composition is close and unstable in an intentional way: energetic line clusters push against blank areas, and the off-center head feels caught mid-turn. Its dry, abrasive texture keeps the study direct and psychological rather than polished. The overall image is intimate, angular and charged with nervous motion.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形铅笔墨线习作在发黄奶油纸上呈现一位年轻男子的头肩。躯干朝右，头却向观者后仰，面孔形成挑衅般的斜侧角度。密集黑发以不规则团块竖在窄额头上。一支烟从嘴角伸出，左侧有淡烟卷。眼睛半垂，下颌轮廓锐利，颈部稍被拉长。衣服只由迅速的衣领和肩线轻描，下方右侧大部分保留未完成纸面。头周围可见试探性铅笔线、交叉辅助线和散乱刮痕。脸部更重，脸颊、鼻与眼下布满粗排线。颜色限于黑、石墨灰与发黄奶油色，纸边有更暖的染色。光宽阔而不刻意，由额头和脸颊未画纸面暗示，而非被画出的光源。构图有意贴近且不稳定：活跃线团推向空白区域，偏心的头像在转动中被抓住。干燥而磨擦感强的纹理使习作直接且心理化，而非精致。整体亲密、有棱角，充满紧张运动。
style_prompt_en: The pencil and ink study retains exploratory construction lines, abrasive hatching and broad unworked paper. Black and graphite gray marks gather densely around one angular focal area, then break into sparse scratches and cream negative space. Light is implied by untouched paper, with shadows built from overlapping dry lines. Slight asymmetry and restless contour changes give the frame psychological tension. The aged surface and unfinished passages are essential to its immediacy.
style_prompt_zh: 这种铅笔墨线习作保留试探性结构线、磨擦排线和大片未画纸面。黑与石墨灰笔痕在一处棱角焦点区密集聚合，随后碎成稀疏刮痕与奶油色留白。光由未触纸面暗示，阴影由重叠干线建立。轻微不对称和躁动的轮廓变化给画面心理张力。旧纸表面与未完成段落是其即时感的关键。
theme_en: A young man with a cigarette in a restless pencil study
theme_zh: 躁动铅笔习作中衔烟的年轻男子
name: Egon Schiele
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
